result.topic_en: Statement of Problem I on the vibratory motion of an entirely free elastic lamina (or one lying on a horizontal plane), setting up the differential equation, its general integral, and the boundary conditions at the free end.
result.transcription:
LAMINARVM ELASTICARVM. 469
Problema I.
XXIII. Si lamina prorſus fuerit libera ſeu in- Tab. VII. Fig. 4.
cumbat plano horizontali; definire motum vibratorium,
cuius eſt capax.
Solutio.
Sit longitudo laminae $AB = a$, quae elapſo
tempore $t$ figuram ceperit AYB, quam minime ab
axe AB diſcrepantem, ipſa autem lamina ita ſit
comparata, quemadmodum ſupra deſcripſimus, ſcili-
cet longitudini $k$ reſpondeat pondus K et pro cur-
vatura, cuius radius oſculi $= r$, ſit momen-
tum elaſticitatis $= \frac{Kcc}{r}$, vnde ponatur $b^4 = 2hkcc$,
quadratum autem $cc$ per experimentum ſupra alle-
gatum inuentum ſit
$cc = \frac{1}{2}\frac{I.k^3}{iK}$ hincque $b^4 = \frac{2}{2}\frac{I\,b.k^4}{iK}$ [?],
quibus poſitis ſi abſciſſae cuicunque $AX = x$ reſpon-
deat applicata $XY = y$; manifeſtum eſt, iterum per-
veniri ad hanc aequationem differentialem
$\left(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}\right) = b^4\left(\frac{d^4y}{dx^4}\right)$
eique idcirco ſatisfacere hanc integralem
$y = \cos.\theta\theta t\left(A\cos.\frac{\theta x}{b} + B\sin.\frac{\theta x}{b} + Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}} + De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}}\right)$
quare quum extremitas F nullam ſuſtineat vim, hoc
loco tam $\left(\frac{ddy}{dx^2}\right)$ quam $\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\right)$ euaneſcet, vnde iam hae
duae determinationes prodeunt
$A = C + D$; et $B = C - D$.

items.quote: Si lamina prorſus fuerit libera ſeu incumbat plano horizontali; definire motum vibratorium, cuius eſt capax.
items.english: If the lamina is entirely free, or rests on a horizontal plane, to determine the vibratory motion of which it is capable.
